items.label: Sturdy Plant Support Stake
items.value: These sturdy metal garden stakes provide essential support for your plants, encouraging straight and healthy growth. They prevent plants from toppling or breaking due to wind, rain, or the weight of flowers and fruit. These versatile stakes can also be used to create neat borders and pathways, adding aesthetic appeal to your garden.

items.label: Durable & Reusable Plant Stakes
items.value: These green, rust-resistant peony cages blend seamlessly into your garden while providing essential support. The durable metal stakes won't rot, and their detachable, stackable design ensures easy storage and reuse year after year.

items.label: Easy-to-use
items.value: Simply push these plant stakes into the ground for quick and easy support. Use them individually or connect them to create circles, rows, cloverleaf shapes, and more. Ideal for both indoor and outdoor plants.

items.label: Multi Size Plant Support Cage
items.value: Available in multiple sizes, these versatile plant supports are ideal for everything from tomatoes and peonies to flowers like monsteras, verbenas, zinnias, daisies, orchids, roses, and peppers. They're also great for supporting leafy and bushy plants.

items.label: Package Includes
items.value: This set includes 8 half-round plant support stakes and 15 green labels. The stakes can be used individually or connected together to create various shapes and sizes, depending on your plant's needs.
